I replied to Marcus in your DM: his Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups go through **Gate 35 (Juniper)**. I also asked him to tell me if that has changed.

I also have a note from Ilse Varga's private DM saying she uses Bay 41 for the same customer. Those were her own messages, so I didn't mention them to Marcus.
